newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end holiday trade mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end holiday trade mixed.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures finished a thinly-traded holiday session mixed, after S&P 500s managed to reach another all-time high.
December S&P 500s reached new highs three times during the day, twice in morning trade and once more before the close the session.
"We barely made a new high and then came off right away," said Kevin O'Brien, stock index futures analyst for Prudential Securities on the floor of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
Traders linked calm dealings to the Veterans' Day holiday today and the closure of the U.S. Treasuries market.
O'Brien noted that the last push of the day up to a new all-time high in December S&Ps was led by an advance in the cash market, which prompted short-covering in futures.
However, volume was low, as it had been most of the session, and trade was thin and dominated by locals.

Early in the session, futures rose from an opening decline when locals covered short positions from day trades, traders said. December S&Ps reached a new contract high, which was again penetrated during morning dealings.

Trade could remain thin Tuesday as participants wait for U.S. economic data scheduled to be released Wednesday, as well as the Federal Open Market Committee meeting, which also is scheduled for Wednesday.
Still, O'Brien noted that bullish sentiment measures in the equity market are declining, despite recent advances to new all-time highs, a positive sign for continued strength.
Historically as well, during election years prices of equities have advanced through the end of the year, O'Brien said.
Nikkei 225 index futures finished lower, but on the highs of the session after declines in the spot index overnight.

At settlement, December S&P 500s were off 0.15 point at 734.10, Russell 2000s gained 1.30 point to 348.20, Value Line futures were up 1.20 point to 663.10, Nikkei 225 index futures eased 100.0 to 21100.0 and Midcap 400s rose 0.45 point to 251.25.
